prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / background replacement.
Asset type: finished full-bleed 16:9 Japanese anime game title illustration for Refrain.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET. Preserve Mina exactly in her existing pose, size, position, silhouette, face, costume, headdress, hands, hair strands and framing. The existing localized hair animation depends on these positions.
Input image 2: STYLE AND WORLD REFERENCE for the new background only. It depicts the interior of the social network Y, not physical architecture.
Primary request: Replace ONLY the rooftop, skyline and sky in image 1. Make the game's premise visually legible: Mina lives inside a social-media timeline and reaches out to recover feelings erased before they could be posted. She has never stood on a real rooftop.
New background: an elegant layered stream of recognizable social posts in the digital darkness, with circular account avatars, short grey message strokes, everyday photo thumbnails, reply/repost outlines and small muted rose hearts. Not a generic science-fiction space. No buildings, floor, railings, clouds, sky or real horizon outside the tiny photos. Keep the entire canvas one continuous image.
Composition: Preserve the left 40% as a calm low-contrast charcoal menu area, with only faint recessed traces of posts, NOT a separate panel. In the open strip just to the left of Mina (x43-57%), show two or three clearly recognizable medium-size social posts at different depths: one with a small ordinary coffee/plant photo, and below it a fading unsent message. Place that unsent draft at x44-56%, y50-62%, just above and left of her extended hand. Its incomplete message lines dissolve at one edge into a restrained thin warm ivory-gold trail that visually leads toward her hand. This small warm trace is the emotional focal point, not an explosion or magical orb. Elsewhere the posts recede softly behind her, airy and asymmetrical, no dense repeating wallpaper.
Style: same high-quality delicate cel-shaded anime linework as Mina, refined translucent painted glass for the posts. Neutral charcoal, restrained mint/cyan outlines, pearl-white post surfaces, muted rose hearts, small warm pale-gold draft trace. Keep Mina brightly readable, her current silver hair and blue eyes, original cool navy maid costume, all fingers and facial features unchanged. Preserve existing character lighting; adapt the new background light to it.
Avoid: camera reframing, shifting or resizing Mina, changed hands or expression, new people, smartphones held in hands, cityscapes, space stations, portals, checkerboard backgrounds, decorative orbs, bokeh, broad luminous rings, dense sparks, extra title text, slogans, watermark, logos or a giant screen border. No legible words in posts; use clean short message strokes. Opaque finished image, same 1672x941 landscape framing as input 1.
